{{Quote|That's Dexter Jettster's slider garnish. I'd know it anywhere.''"<br />"''Congratulations. Our best clue is a garnish.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Siri Tachi|<ref name="False Peace">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref>}}
'''Slider garnish''',<ref name="False Peace"/> also called '''special garnish'''<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> was a type of [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]] used as a garnish on the [[slider]]s served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. These included [[Coruscant slider]]s, [[Giju slider]]s, [[Khomm slider]]s, [[Socorro slider]]s, [[Vorzyd slider/Legends|Vorzyd slider]]s, and [[Zeltros slider]]s.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> The sause was popular among the diner's patrons and the diner's [[Chef/Legends|chef]], [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], even considered selling bottles of the sauce.<ref name="False Peace"/>  

By [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was familiar enough with the sauce to be able to identify it by taste.<ref name="False Peace"/> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> while searching in a [[Virtual Happiness|building]] in the Coruscant's [[Business district (Coruscant)|business district]] for a [[Slams|group]] of criminals, Kenobi discovered a dirty plate with a puddle of the sauce on it. After tasting it, Kenobi and his [[Padawan/Legends|padawn]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] visited Dex's Diner and with help from Jettster learned more of the criminal's plan.<ref name="False Peace"/>  

==Behind the scenes==
Slider garnish first appeared in ''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]'', the ninth book in the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Quest]]'' series. The book was written by [[Jude Watson]] and released in [[2004]].<ref name="False Peace"/> The sauce was first identified as special garnish in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
